# JSBSim source

This directory contains the upstream JSBSim `src/` tree from
`JSBSim-Team/jsbsim`, revision `3f153c18a2518f8472e37c89e70444b1c671b700`
(upstream version 1.3.4.dev1).

The shared library is built separately from OpenSky and dynamically linked by
the simulator. The upstream license is included in `COPYING.LGPL-2.1`; the
third-party notices inside `src/` remain with their corresponding source files.
OpenSky aircraft files are authored separately under `game/aircraft/` and do
not copy aircraft configurations from the upstream repository.

Upstream project: <https://github.com/JSBSim-Team/jsbsim>
